## notes

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(ggpubr)

my_theme <-  theme_classic(6) + theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),  #rotate & align axis
  axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
  axis.title.x = element_blank(),
  axis.line = element_line(size = 0.2),
  axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.2),
  strip.background = element_blank(),
  strip.placement = "outside"
)
```

# nuc intensity
```{r}
#load data
data <- read.csv("~/Documents/Stanford Postdoc/Analyses/20200420_cdsSPCH Col background/4dpg/20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_v1_exp_data_combo.csv")
data
```

```{r}
#data$sampleleaf <- paste(data$sample, data$leaf)
#data <- data[data$sample != "gSPCH_3", ]   #remove sample with no index
#colnames(data)[6:6] <- c("cell.type")

#data <- data[data$cell2 %in% c("SLGC>P", "M","GMC", "GC"), ]
data$cell2 <- factor(data$cell2, levels = c("SLGC>P", "M","GMC", "GC"))

ggplot(data, aes(x = cell2, y = Mean)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.05) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  ylab("relative intensity") +
    stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", alpha = 5, width = 0.5, size = 0.1, color = "black") +
  my_theme + facet_wrap(.~geno, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top")

ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_mean_v1.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1)
```

cds

boxplots
```{r}
#give.n <- function(x){
#   return(c(y = max(x) + 0.05, label = length(x)))
#}

give.n <- function(x){
   return(c(y = max(x) + 100, label = length(x)))
}

ggplot(data[data$cell2 %in% c("SLGC>P", "M","GMC"), ], aes(x = cell2, y = Mean)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.05, color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", width = 0.25, outlier.shape = 32, alpha = 0, lwd = 0.2) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  ylab("relative intensity") +
  #stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", alpha = 5, width = 0.5, size = 0.1, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = give.n, geom = "text", size = 1.5, color = "darkgrey") + 
  my_theme + facet_wrap(.~geno, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top")

ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_mean_noGC_v3.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1.5)


ggplot(data, aes(x = cell2, y = Mean)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.05, color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", width = 0.25, outlier.shape = 32, alpha = 0, lwd = 0.2) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  ylab("relative intensity") +
  #stat_summary(fun = "median", geom = "crossbar", alpha = 5, width = 0.5, size = 0.1, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = give.n, geom = "text", size = 1.5, color = "darkgrey") + 
  my_theme + facet_wrap(.~geno, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top")

ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_mean_wGC_v3.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1.5)
```

w stats - v1
```{r}
my_comparisons <- list(c("SLGC>P","M"), c("SLGC>P","GMC"), c("SLGC>P", "GC"), c("M", "GMC"),c("M", "GC"), c("GMC", "GC"))

ggplot(data, aes(x = cell2, y = Mean)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.05, color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", width = 0.25, outlier.shape = 32, alpha = 0, lwd = 0.2) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  ylab("relative intensity") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, size = 2, method = "wilcox.test", color="dark gray",
                     bracket.size = 0.2, tip.length = 0.02) +
  my_theme + facet_wrap(.~geno, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top")
ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_mean_boxplot_v4.pdf", width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
```

v2
```{r}
my_comparisons <- rev(list(c("SLGC>P", "GC"),c("M", "GC"),c("GMC", "GC")))

ggplot(data, aes(x = cell2, y = Mean)) +
  geom_jitter(size = 0.1, alpha = 0.2, width = 0.05, color = "darkgrey") +
  geom_boxplot(color = "black", width = 0.25, outlier.shape = 32, alpha = 0, lwd = 0.2) +
  #scale_colour_manual(values = c("black", "black", "black")) +
  ylab("relative intensity") +
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons, size = 3, method = "wilcox.test", color="dark gray",
                     bracket.size = 0.2, tip.length = 0.02) +
  my_theme + facet_wrap(.~geno, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "top")
ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_mean_boxplot_v5.pdf", width = 1.5, height = 1.5)
```

plot all
```{r}
plot3$frac <- factor(plot3$frac, levels = c("GC_noexp", "GC_exp", "GMC_noexp","GMC_exp", "M_noexp", "M_exp", "SLGC_noexp", "SLGC_exp"))

ggplot(plot3, aes(x = geno)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        #plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(col)) +
  ylab("fraction (field of view)") +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = frac), position = "fill", lwd = 0.2, color = "white")
ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_freq_v1.pdf", width = 1.1, height = 1.5)     #edit labels manually

#plot individually & put next to dot plot?
```

plot with greyed out M>GMC>GC
```{r}
temp <- plot3
temp$frac <- gsub("^M", "fav", temp$frac)     #^start and end$
temp$frac <- gsub("^GMC", "fav", temp$frac)
temp$frac <- gsub("^GC", "fav", temp$frac)
unique(temp$frac) #[1] "SLGC_exp"   "SLGC_noexp" "fav_exp"     "fav_noexp"  
temp$frac <- factor(temp$frac, levels = c("fav_noexp", "fav_exp", "SLGC_noexp", "SLGC_exp"))

ggplot(temp, aes(x = geno)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 6) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.1, "lines"),
        legend.margin=margin(0,0,0,0),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        #plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "cm")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rev(c("darkgrey", "lightgrey", "darkgrey", "lightgrey"))) +
  ylab("fraction (field of view)") +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = frac), position = "fill", lwd = 0.2, color = "white")
ggsave("20200501_4dpgSPCH_quant_freq_v2.pdf", width = 1.1, height = 1.5)     #edit labels manually
```
